skill.name: stream-chain
skill.description: Orchestrates sequential prompt chains and predefined pipelines for streamed multi-agent development workflows.
skill.summary: Build sequential multi-agent workflows where each step uses the prior result as context.
skill.author: DNYoussef

content.value_statement: Sequential AI workflows often lose context between steps. This skill defines stream-chain patterns that pass each result into the next task.
actual_capabilities: Defines custom stream-chain workflows with two or more sequential prompts.
Documents predefined pipelines for analysis, refactoring, testing, and optimization.
Shows how prior step output becomes context for later tasks.
Explains timeout, verbose, and debug options for chain execution.
Provides examples for code review, migration, security review, and data transformation.
limitations: Requires a working claude-flow stream-chain command in the user environment.
Does not include executable implementation files inside the skill package.
Outputs depend on the connected agent models and project context.
Long or complex chains may need higher per-step timeout values.

use_cases.title: Plan a feature delivery chain
use_cases.description: Create a sequence that analyzes requirements, designs architecture, implements code, writes tests, and documents the result.

use_cases.title: Audit code quality systematically
use_cases.description: Run analysis, refactor, test, and optimization steps as a repeatable review workflow.

use_cases.title: Transform project data through stages
use_cases.description: Structure extraction, normalization, validation, enrichment, and reporting tasks as a chained data workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple chain
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow with three clear steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a stream-chain workflow that analyzes a small module, suggests improvements, and writes a short action plan.

prompt_templates.title: Use a predefined pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard codebase analysis with existing pipeline names.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to run the analysis pipeline, explain each stage, and describe the expected final report.

prompt_templates.title: Design a custom delivery workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate project workflow for feature development.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a five-step stream-chain plan for a new API feature, including design, implementation, tests, documentation, and review.

prompt_templates.title: Tune an advanced migration chain
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with timeout, debug, and validation needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an advanced migration chain with validation steps, timeout guidance, debug usage, and a final rollback checklist.

output_examples.input: Analyze a payment module, improve reliability, and generate tests.
output_examples.output: A staged workflow with analysis findings, prioritized fixes, targeted tests, and a final verification summary.

output_examples.input: Run a migration assistant for a legacy frontend project.
output_examples.output: A migration plan that lists breaking changes, update priorities, validation tasks, and documentation needs.

output_examples.input: Create a data quality workflow for imported customer records.
output_examples.output: A chain that extracts records, normalizes fields, validates quality, enriches missing context, and reports issues.

best_practices: Use specific prompts so each chain step has a measurable result.
Place verification steps after implementation or transformation steps.
Increase timeouts for analysis, migration, or large codebase workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague prompts such as check everything or improve code.
Do not chain unrelated tasks that need separate context or review.
Do not skip validation when a chain changes code or data structures.

faq.question: What does this skill help automate?
faq.answer: It helps define sequential prompt workflows where each step uses the previous step output as context.

faq.question: Does this skill include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The package contains documentation for using stream-chain commands and workflow patterns.

faq.question: Which predefined pipelines are documented?
faq.answer: It documents analysis, refactor, test, and optimize pipelines for common development workflows.

faq.question: Can I create custom pipelines?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains how to define reusable stream-chain pipelines in a configuration file.

faq.question: How does context move between steps?
faq.answer: Each step receives the previous output, then adds a new task for the next stage.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code marketplace contexts.
